definition.simple: The special tubes in a plant that act like a food delivery service, carrying the food made by the leaves to all other parts of the plant.
definition.academic: The vascular tissue in plants that conducts sugars and other metabolic products downward from the leaves.

examples: The sweet sap that comes out of some trees (like maple syrup) travels through the phloem.

common_misconceptions: Students often think phloem only transports food downwards. Actually, phloem can transport food in both directions, wherever it is needed.
ai_context.tutor_hint: Ask the student how the roots, which are underground and can't make food, get their energy.
